extractor.name: cics-dita-source-projector
extractor.fragment_digest_definition: SHA-256 over ASCII domain mainframe-env.cics-source-fragment@1, one NUL byte (0x00), then UTF-8 order-preserving whitespace-normalized visible text of the selected DOM subtree

projection_digest_definition: SHA-256 over ASCII domain mainframe-env.cics-source-candidates@1, one NUL byte (0x00), then UTF-8 JSON with ensure_ascii=true, sort_keys=true and separators=(',', ':') of the complete candidate projection with projection_sha256 omitted
